  OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%cimetidine%'
  OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%nizatidine%'
  OR concept_class_id = 'Class - H2 receptor antagonists'
LIMIT 20;

SELECT concept_id, concept_name, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%clostridioides%'
  OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%claudifer%'
  OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%campylobacteroides%'
LIMIT 20;
